instruction: On your Ubuntu Desktop, update the filename 'poster_party_night.webp' to 'party_event.webp'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming the poster_party_night.webp file to party_event.webp on Desktop. The evaluator verifies both that the new filename exists and the old filename no longer exists. No custom functions needed - reuses existing vm_command_line getter and exact_match metric.

Correct logic: Shell command properly uses '[ -f ... ] && [ ! -f ... ]' to verify both file existence and non-existence
Appropriate function usage: vm_command_line getter is the correct choice for filesystem verification, exact_match metric correctly compares output
